mapper.select: SELECT ship.SHIP_DATE as shipDate, part.PART_NUMBER_SHORT as partNumber, msn.SERIAL_NUMBER as serialNumber, mo.MO_OID as rmaNumber, ship.TRACKING_NUMBER as trackingNumber, xm.CUSTOMER_REPORTED_ISSUE_EXT as reportedIssue, fault.VALUE as faultCode FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_ORDER mo JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_MATERIALS xm USING (MO_OID) JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER msn USING (MSN_OID) JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_PART part USING (PART_OID) JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_SHIP ship USING (BOX_OID) JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_FAULT_CODE xfc USING (xm_OID) JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_FAULT_CODE_VALUES fault ON fault.SFV_OID = xfc.FAULT_CODE WHERE mo.MC_OID = 321 ORDER BY ship.SHIP_DATE DESC;
